svg.title: Personal Josy — simbolo — escuro
svg.desc: Personal Josy. Calendário amarelo com recorte transparente em J e presilhas brancas; assinatura em Poppins SemiBold quando presente.
svg.metadata: Poppins SemiBold 600: contours from the official Indian Type Foundry Poppins 4.003 TTX source. Copyright 2014-2019 Indian Type Foundry. SIL Open Font License 1.1. Word spacing and kerning optically adjusted. Calendar symbol: original normalized geometry based on the user-approved concept. No embedded bitmap, external fonts, animation, scripts, or external resources. Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itfoundry/Poppins/master/products/Poppins-4.003-GoogleFonts-TTF/Poppins-SemiBold.ttx
